rules: Whole allow ids сверяются scalar/query в одном authority snapshot/now, 100 seeds, плюс independent literal ids CRM. Before/common/role/condition/restriction/veto отдельные denial controls. Native Builder supported shapes same scalar/list/count. External model=null no exact adapter throws before pagination. Query/parameters/chunks/count measured 10k clients/100 scopes; no one-query-per-Client/role N+1. EXPLAIN100000Clients uses actual P3 composite tenant_key/context_key indexes + host resource indexes, не несуществующий context_type/context_id index. Host input change same DB T пересчитывает list. Cross-connection no unauthorized joins; materialized witnesses ≤1000. R35 complete bounded universe, policy-only outside grants.
